printing: Meric Casaubon, A True & Faithful Relation (London, 1659)
notes: On pp. 134 to 137 the printing runs pieces of several calls together. The pieces are put under their calls here by the first words Dee lists on p. 200, by his margin notes against the English on pp. 193 and 194, and by the order of the English there. The printing itself does not mark where each piece belongs.
ILS and DIALPERT are printed on p. 136 after 'That is the Twelfth'. SOBA to YLSI are printed on p. 135. SOBAIAD to TOATAR are printed on p. 137 before 'That is the thirteenth'.
